usdRate.sourceName: European Central Bank euro reference rate (USD)
usdRate.note: EUR 1 = USD 1.1172 on 30 October 2026 (ECB EXR dataset), so about EUR 0.895 per US dollar; World Bank 2025 average 0.885.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics, reporting the STATEC national consumer price index for September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: Annual CPI inflation 2.9% in September 2026 (2.2% in August, highest since April). Secondary source: the STATEC release itself could not be found; World Bank 2025 average 2.3%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: ECB 2% medium-term target; Luxembourg CPI averaged about 3.4% a year in 2021-2025 (6.3% in 2022); STATEC 2026 forecast 1.8-2.9%
inflation_projection.note: Luxembourg shares the ECB 2% target but has run slightly above it, so 2.5% is used for long-run planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: European Central Bank, key ECB interest rates (deposit facility)
policy_rate.note: Luxembourg uses the euro; ECB deposit facility rate 2.50% since 16 September 2026 (2.25% from June 2026), confirmed in the ECB FM dataset on 31 October 2026.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Luxembourg banks, overnight deposits from households (new business)
savings_account_rate.note: Average rate on household overnight deposits in Luxembourg, August 2026 (0.59% in July).

fdr_3m_rate.note: ECB/BCL MFI statistics publish household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year as one bucket (2.00% in August 2026); no separate 3-month term deposit rate was found.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Luxembourg banks, household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year (new business)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Bucket covers all fixed terms up to one year (1.81% in July); 1-2 year deposits paid 2.55% in August 2026.

dps_rate.note: Banks sell monthly savings plans, but no average or official rate for them was found in BCL or ECB statistics.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Luxembourg banks, household deposits with agreed maturity (outstanding amounts)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average rate on all outstanding household term deposits (1.86% in July); household overnight deposits paid 0.60%. World Bank FR.INR.DPST has no Luxembourg figure.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No retail government savings certificate or savings bond for individuals was found; Luxembourg government bonds are syndicated to institutional investors and only traded on the secondary market.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No 3-month Luxembourg treasury bill yield was found; the state funds itself mainly with medium- and long-term bonds.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No published 5-year Luxembourg government bond yield was found from the BCL, ECB or an allowed secondary source.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: ECB long-term interest rate for convergence purposes, Luxembourg
tbond_10y_rate.note: Monthly average 3.697% for September 2026 (3.40% in August, 3.30% in July); Luxembourg has few bonds outstanding, so the figure is indicative.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Luxembourg income determination (investment income)
tax_bank_interest.note: Savings interest paid to resident individuals bears a 20% withholding tax in full discharge of income tax (Relibi); interest not covered by it is taxed at progressive rates after a EUR 1,500 investment-income allowance.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No retail government savings certificate exists; interest on government bonds is ordinary savings interest under the 20% final withholding.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Fonds de garantie des dépôts Luxembourg (FGDL), deposit guarantee
deposit_insurance_limit.note: EUR 100,000 per person per bank; certain temporary high balances (property sales, life events) are protected up to EUR 2,500,000.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Luxembourg banks, revolving loans, overdrafts and credit card credit to households
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Typical rate, not a cap: average rate on household revolving loans, overdrafts and credit card credit, August 2026.

equity_return_low.sourceName: 1-year deposit 2.00% less 20% tax = 1.6% (ECB MFI); long-run euro-area equity returns
equity_return_low.note: Low case: a diversified euro equity fund earns little more than safe savings over a long period.

equity_return_base.sourceName: 1-year deposit 2.00% less 20% tax = 1.6% (ECB MFI) plus an equity premium of about 4 points
equity_return_base.note: The local LuxX index is tiny and concentrated, so the base uses a diversified euro/global equity fund in euros, capped at the after-tax safe rate plus about 4 points.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Long-run global equity returns in euros
equity_return_high.note: High case: a diversified equity fund matching long-run global equity returns of about 7-8% in euros.

gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold barely keeps up after the 2025-26 spike, with no help from the euro.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); ECB 2% inflation target
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises roughly with world inflation plus a little, and the euro is assumed stable against the dollar over the long run.

gold_return_high.note: High case: a repeat of gold's strong 2005-2025 trend in euro terms.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 2.00% (ECB MFI statistics), assuming rates fall, less 20% withholding
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: term deposit rates drift down towards 1.25% before the 20% withholding.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 2.00% less 20% withholding = 1.6%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: after-tax 1-year term deposit rate.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: locking in longer term deposits after tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The Commissariat aux Assurances publishes market statistics but no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover (assurance temporaire décès) is sold, but no regulator or other non-company published premium table per EUR 1,000 of cover was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Hospital care for people insured with the CNS is largely covered, with a small daily patient contribution; no official figure for the out-of-pocket cost of a major hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: Complementary health cover is sold by mutual societies and insurers, but no published premium table per EUR 100,000 of cover was found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Luxembourg CPI, health: +1.7% year on year in September 2026 (Trading Economics, from STATEC); HICP health +2.5% in Dec 2025 (ECB)
goal_inflation_health.note: Measured health prices rise slowly because most care is CNS-reimbursed, but the cost of uncovered care is assumed to rise about a point above the 2.5% planning inflation.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Luxembourg CPI, education: +0.6% year on year in September 2026 (6.2% in August) (Trading Economics, from STATEC)
goal_inflation_education.note: Education price growth swings with fee changes; over the long run it is assumed to run about a point above the 2.5% planning inflation, in line with wage indexation.

life_expectancy.sourceName: Eurostat demo_mlexpec, life expectancy at birth, Luxembourg
life_expectancy.note: 2024 figure (latest published; older than 2025): men 81.0, women 85.5. World Bank 2024 figure 83.2.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: Eurostat demo_mlexpec, life expectancy by age and sex, Luxembourg
life_table_remaining.note: 2024 period life table (latest published; older than 2025).

support_ratio.sourceName: Eurostat EUROPOP2023 population projections, proj_23ndbi old-age dependency ratio (65+ to 15-64), baseline
support_ratio.note: 100 divided by the projected old-age dependency ratio: 22.6 in 2026, 30.6 in 2040, 47.9 in 2065. World Bank 2025 ratio 23.1 gives 4.3.

retirement_age_default.sourceName: CNAP (Caisse nationale d'assurance pension), information about the pension scheme changes in 2026
retirement_age_default.note: The 2026 reform keeps the legal pension age at 65 (10 years of insurance needed), same for men and women; early pension from 57 (40 years of compulsory insurance) or 60 (40 years incl. credited periods), with the required career for early pensions rising gradually from 1 July 2026.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: IGSS (Inspection générale de la sécurité sociale), Aperçu no. 16: long-term sustainability of public pension schemes
retirement_age_government.note: Older than 2025: civil servants are covered by the special schemes (régimes spéciaux), which follow the same age rules as the general scheme: old-age pension at 65, early pension from 57 or 60 after 40 years.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 2.00% (ECB MFI), assuming rates fall, less 20% withholding
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: term deposit rates drift lower.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 2.00% less 20% withholding = 1.6%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case capped at the after-tax 1-year term deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of longer term deposits after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half shares at 5.5% and half safe fixed income at about 1.6-2% after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No dedicated non-contributory old-age pension was found: the minimum pension needs 20 years of insurance (CNAP), and older people without enough record rely on the means-tested social inclusion income (REVIS, Fonds national de solidarité), which is a top-up to an income threshold rather than a fixed benefit.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No dedicated non-contributory old-age pension found; REVIS (means-tested minimum income) is open to residents of any age from 25, including pensioners.

gratuity_rule.note: No per-year gratuity: the Labour Code gives a severance allowance on dismissal by the employer in steps of 1 to 12 months' wages after 5 to 30 years of service, which does not fit a days-per-year rule; no readable official page with the table was found.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: CNAP, 2026 pension scheme changes; IGSS Aperçu no. 16 (indexation)
public_pension_scheme.note: General pension insurance scheme run by the CNAP: pension from 65 after 10 years of insurance; minimum pension after 20 years. Pensions are indexed to the cost of living and adjusted to real wage growth (IGSS). Contribution rate rose from 24% to 25.5% in 2026, shared by employer, employee and state. Pensions are taxed as ordinary income.

dps.note: Banks offer regular monthly savings plans; no average rate is published.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No retail government savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: No 3-month treasury bill for retail investors was found.

tbond_5y.note: Few lines outstanding, bought on the secondary market; no 5-year yield found.

equity_fund.note: Retail funds widely available; Luxembourg is Europe's largest fund domicile.

gold.note: No restriction on buying physical gold; investment gold is VAT-exempt under EU rules.

centralBank.name: Banque centrale du Luxembourg (BCL)
centralBank.note: Part of the Eurosystem; monetary policy set by the European Central Bank.

insuranceComplaints.name: Commissariat aux Assurances, out-of-court settlement of disputes

depositInsurance.name: Fonds de garantie des dépôts Luxembourg (FGDL)

statistics.name: STATEC (National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies)
